findings.claim: The coverage script does not enforce the stated per-file coverage requirement for every source file or for lib/platform and rules; it only thresholds rules/build.mjs.
findings.evidence: openspec/specs/project-tooling/spec.md now requires `coverage` to "report line coverage for every source file" and "fail when a file falls below its threshold", and tasks.md 4.1 requires line coverage over `lib/platform/` and `rules/` to be at least 80%, but `scripts/coverage-report.mjs` defines `const TARGETS = ['rules/build.mjs'];` and applies `THRESHOLD` only while iterating that list.
findings.suggested_fix: Discover and threshold all relevant source files under `lib/platform/` and `rules/` (or explicitly list them), and fail if any file is absent from coverage data or below the required threshold.
